title: Simplify Python function
prompt: `src/parser.py` builds its result with a manual index loop and an `if`/`else` that appends the same kind of value twice. Rewrite `parse_pairs` to be idiomatic Python using a single comprehension, preserving behaviour exactly (a malformed entry with no separator must still be skipped). The `while` loop, the `if`/`else` and the mutable `result` dict must all be gone.
